summary: RETEST of BPM Column fix — PASS. Uploaded /tmp/a.wav (120 BPM) and /tmp/b.wav (140 BPM) into a new playlist, clicked track-list-panel to satisfy the AudioContext user-gesture requirement, and observed that track-bpm-0 and track-bpm-1 populated with numeric values ('120' and '140', cyan digits) within ~1s — they no longer stay stuck on '···'. Also confirmed standby arm on track 1 renders the STANDBY BPM readout ('b → 140 BPM') AND the track-bpm-1 column cell continues to show '140' (onBpm callback reflected into tracks state). Quick regression: no runtime-error overlay, and standby-sync, standby-sync-lock, standby-take, fader-curve-smooth, fader-curve-sharp are all present.

critical_code_review_comments: audioEngine.bpmFor now correctly resumes suspended AudioContext before decodeAudioData and invokes onBpm(trackId,bpm) — behavior matches spec.

context_for_next_testing_agent: BPM column fix verified. track-bpm-{index} now populates within ~1s of a single user gesture after upload. Reuse /tmp/a.wav (120) and /tmp/b.wav (140). Seed license via localStorage key 'hotlive95_license'.
rca of the issue: Previously the AudioContext was suspended (autoplay policy) at the moment bpmFor tried to decodeAudioData for the background BPM pass, causing decode/analysis to fail silently and the cell to remain '···'. Fix: (1) audioEngine.bpmFor awaits ctx.resume() when suspended prior to decode; (2) new onBpm callback pushes detected BPM into React tracks state; (3) App.js background pass retries up to 8x @ 1.5s intervals picking least-attempted track and no longer overwrites bpm with 0 on failure. Verified: single click on track-list-panel is sufficient gesture, and cells populate rapidly.
